measurable_change.description: The Salvation Army closed its Washington City center and four-day-a-week food pantry after rising rent and an expiring lease made the building financially unsustainable. The pantry had supplied food boxes to about 500 low-income families each month. Staff and volunteers continue taking requests and delivering food to housing complexes, but the fixed-site pantry remains closed.
